dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: The trailing edge exhibits a pronounced concave spline profile, curving posteriorly from the apex before transitioning to a steeper vertical drop near the dorsal ridge junction.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Rounded morphology with a moderate pixel radius; lacks acute or obtuse angular termination.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Long, low-angle anterior margin gradually ascending at approximately 20-25 degrees relative to the horizontal body axis before increasing in pitch near the apex.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: The longitudinal base of the visible fin structure is significantly elongated relative to its vertical height, showing an approximate 4:1 pixel ratio.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Minor irregular nicks along the upper third of the trailing edge; multiple small, circular white punctate markings (possibly healed parasitic lesions) on the lateral flank and peduncle area.
other_distinctive_markers: Distinct mottled light-grey pigmentation patch visible on the central-lower portion of the dorsal fin, contrasting with the darker primary pigmentation.
